count_boundaries: One final accepted image per listed camera; corrections/retries excluded.

No Cartesian product of all bedrooms × all bathrooms × all bases.
Commercial/hospitality 11 cards, outdoor 2 cards and archive 15 cards are outside this 39+57 estimate; they require explicit separate adaptation scope.
A902 has no standalone study, child, hall, wardrobe-room or terrace camera in this 7-view manifest. Wardrobe design is counted in existing master views only.

Open-plan consistency: a separate kitchen/dining study is a module comparison, not a new complete 38-view home. If a chosen module changes visible furniture in other views, regenerate only affected cameras as a later selected variant.
Stair-only GD24_F13 and meditation GD021 have zero direct default room slots; optional dry-room/detail adaptations are separately counted.
Nominal master/wardrobe cameras may overlap; set union removes duplicate cameras.
